name: smwgraphics-armless-yoshi
title: Armless Yoshi
description:
Step right up and behold a true marvel of modern science and evolutionary choices! It's Yoshi, but he's got no arms! That's right, ladies and gents, NO ARMS!

Watch in amazement as he runs, jumps, and flutters using nothing but grit and pure leg power! How does he eat? That's the mystery, friends, that's the magic!

This incredible specimen uses the standard vanilla palette and replaces GFX33. Drop him into your game and give your players a sight they won't soon forget! Get your armless Yoshi today!
